ajuda_acompanhar_operacao_nota_1: You get an alert every time the stage changes.

ajuda_anunciar_maquina_nota_2: Only the city appears on the listing. You arrange the address and pickup in the negotiation.

ajuda_anunciar_maquina_resumo: Sell or rent it out by the hour, day or hectare, with or without an operator.
ajuda_avaliacoes_nota_1: The app sends reminders while the review is pending.
ajuda_avaliacoes_nota_2: Before negotiating, check the reviews on the listing and on the seller’s profile.

ajuda_avaliacoes_passo_2: Choose from 1 to 5 stars and, if you like, write a comment.

ajuda_buscar_e_filtrar_resumo: Find machines, farm inputs and services by type, price and order.

legal_priv_1_anuncios_texto: : titles, descriptions, prices, photos (image addresses), location and quantities of the products, machines and services you publish.
legal_priv_1_aparelho_texto: : if you turn on notifications, we store the technical delivery address provided by the browser.
legal_priv_1_google_texto: , received when you sign in: name, email address and profile photo. We do not have access to your password.
legal_priv_1_informados_texto: : display name, phone number and photo, if you fill them in on your profile.
legal_priv_1_negociacoes_texto: : offers, amounts, dates, chat messages, cancellation reasons and reviews.
legal_priv_1_tecnicos_texto: recorded automatically by the hosting services (such as IP address and access date), used for security and diagnostics.
legal_priv_1_uso_texto: : which screens you open and which actions you take (for example, starting or publishing a listing, sending an offer, search terms), with date and time, and the errors that occur on your screen. These logs are linked to a session identifier and, if you are signed in, to your account. We do
legal_priv_1_uso_texto_2: record the text of messages, your email address, phone number or what you type into forms.
legal_priv_2_item_1: To create and maintain your account and identify you when you sign in (performance of the service).
legal_priv_2_item_2: To publish listings and enable negotiations, bookings and reviews between users.
legal_priv_2_item_3: To send alerts about offers, messages and changes to your bookings.
legal_priv_2_item_4: To protect the app against misuse and fix errors (legitimate interest).
legal_priv_2_item_5: To evaluate the usability of the prototype and fix errors, based on the usage and error logs, for academic purposes. Published results are always aggregated, without identifying participants.
legal_priv_2_p1: We do not sell personal data and we do not use your data for advertising.
legal_priv_3_p1_antes: Your display name, photo, listings and the reviews you receive are public within the app. Your email address and phone number are
legal_priv_3_p1_depois: shown to other users. Messages and offers in a negotiation are seen only by the two parties involved.
legal_priv_3_titulo: 3. What is visible to other users
legal_priv_4_p1: Data is processed by providers that operate the app's infrastructure, solely for that purpose:
legal_priv_4_p2: These services may store data outside Brazil, with the safeguards provided for in the LGPD. We may also share data when required by law or court order.
legal_priv_4_supabase: : database, authentication and delivery of notifications.
legal_priv_5_p1: We keep data for as long as your account exists or for as long as it is needed for the purposes above. Usage and error logs are kept until the end of the project. At the end of the project, or at your request, personal data will be deleted or anonymized, except for what the law requires us to keep.
legal_priv_6_item_1: confirmation that we process your data and access to it;
legal_priv_6_item_2: correction of incomplete or outdated data;
legal_priv_6_item_3: deletion of your account and personal data;
legal_priv_6_item_4: information about who we share your data with;
legal_priv_6_item_5: withdrawal of consent, where consent is the legal basis for processing.
legal_priv_6_p1: Under the LGPD, you may request at any time:

legal_termos_1_p1: Osiris connects those who list agricultural machinery, products and services with those who are looking for them. The app allows users to publish listings, send offers, chat, record the agreed booking and review the other party.
legal_termos_1_p2_depois: process payments, is not a party to the deals made between users and does not guarantee the quality, delivery or existence of what is listed. Payment, delivery and all other terms are agreed directly between the parties.
legal_termos_2_p1: The app is under development and may have errors, become unavailable or change without notice. Demonstration listings may appear in the showcase, and test data may be deleted. Do not use Osiris for deals that depend exclusively on it.
legal_termos_3_item_1: Access is through a Google account; you are responsible for everything done with it.
legal_termos_3_item_2: Keep your profile information accurate and do not impersonate another person or company.
legal_termos_4_item_1: Only list what you are able to sell, rent out or provide, with a truthful description, photos and price.
legal_termos_4_item_2: Listing items that are illegal, stolen, counterfeit or that require an authorization you do not hold (such as unregistered pesticides) is prohibited.
legal_termos_4_item_3: Accepted offers become bookings; cancellations require a reason and are recorded.
legal_termos_4_item_4: Reviews must reflect the actual experience, without offensive content.
